widgets.name: Drift (Read-Only)
widgets.required_schema: DashboardDriftItem: latest_run_id, status, total_findings, critical_count, high_count, medium_count, started_at

service_implementation.method: list_drift(workspace_id, limit=1): SELECT drift_run + COUNT findings by severity
service_implementation.sql: SELECT dr.id, dr.status, dr.started_at, COUNT(df.id) FILTER (WHERE df.severity='critical') as critical_count, COUNT(df.id) FILTER (WHERE df.severity='high') as high_count, COUNT(df.id) FILTER (WHERE df.severity='medium') as medium_count, COUNT(df.id) as total_findings FROM drift_runs dr LEFT JOIN drift_findings df ON df.run_id = dr.id WHERE dr.workspace_id = :ws GROUP BY dr.id ORDER BY dr.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
